<user_query>
On Windows PowerShell, cleanly restart RootMC Ava bot:

1. Kill ALL processes whose CommandLine matches 'rootmc-ava' (node, npm, cmd).
2. Wait 4 seconds. Confirm port 8787 is free.
3. Delete "D:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\Server Handoffs\Ava Ivy\data\liveness.json" if present.
4. Start ONLY: 
   $env:AVA_NO_STATUS_WINDOW='1'
   Start-Process -FilePath 'C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.exe' -ArgumentList 'src/index.mjs' -WorkingDirectory 'D:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\Web Files\rootmc-ava' -WindowStyle Hidden
5. Wait 10 seconds.
6. List remaining rootmc-ava node PIDs with roles (index/server/poller) — should be exactly 1 index + 1 server + 1 poller.
7. GET http://127.0.0.1:8787/health and print degraded, pollerLive, onBreak, gateway.joinWelcomes, gateway.username, children.
8. Tail last 10 lines of status-events.jsonl

Return the health JSON summary and process list. If duplicates remain, kill extras and report.
</user_query>
I'll cleanly restart Ava: kill matching processes, free port 8787, then bring up a single index process and verify health.

input.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine -match 'rootmc-ava' } | ForEach-Object { Write-Output "Killing PID $($_.ProcessId) Name=$($_.Name) Cmd=$($_.CommandLine)"; Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; $left = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine -match 'rootmc-ava' }; if ($left) { $left | ForEach-Object { Write-Output "Still alive PID $($_.ProcessId) - force kill"; Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } } else { Write-Output 'All rootmc-ava processes killed.' }
